scope: Proposition 7.2 (Accuracy of the reference experiment) of the manuscript “An FPRAS for Cell-Bounded Contingency Tables” (preprints/An-FPRAS-for-Cell-Bounded-Contingency-Tables-September-24-2026/main.pdf), one of the manuscripts of result family 115 of openai/math at commit 1581d4cbdd69. The statement is quoted verbatim from the text that pdftotext 24.02.0 (-raw -enc UTF-8) extracts from the PDF (SHA-256 10bad4277d11b9d1), with whitespace normalised, and was found there under this heading on PDF page 38. Text extraction flattens typeset mathematics (superscripts, subscripts, fractions, large operators, delimiters), so the quote can read differently from the typeset statement and can carry characters with no Unicode meaning; the PDF is authoritative. Finding the quote shows that the manuscript states it, not that it is true. AMVO has checked nothing about this claim.
statement: With probability at least 1 − 1/50, the reference experiment does not abort, every stored multiplier collection is good at its own parameter in the sense of (29), and log Zref C(H) ≤ 4Hη. (67)
